blocks.text:
Folio as it comes: the icons your apps ship with in their own shape, red dot badges, and glass tinted from what is behind it.

The status area shows the time, the date and the battery with the ring glyphs. This is the theme to apply to put everything back the way it was.

A built-in Folio theme. Applying it changes how Folio draws your Home screen and nothing else - it never touches other apps, and every setting it changes can be changed back by hand in Settings.

items: The icons apps ship with, in their own shape
Time, date and battery in the status area

entries.notes: The Classic theme becomes a package in the Folio Market. It has shipped with Folio since 0.4.0.
